about.greeting: I am a fullstack developer with a strong bias toward quality and data. I started out reading data on a market intelligence team, learned how production breaks while working in support, and since 2022 I have been building software from the database to the interface. The same thread runs through all three phases: understand the problem before picking the tool.
about.professionalDescription: Today I work fullstack at Stech, on internal and client products, with TypeScript, React, NestJS and Prisma over MySQL, all containerised. Before that: Java and Spring Boot at Persys, the longest tenure of my career; conversion-focused frontend at Make; and test engineering at Outlier, evaluating language models across voice, vision and text. For just over a year I also taught Excel, Power BI and generative AI at Cebrac — teaching is what forces you to actually understand something.
about.expertiseDescription: What I bring to a team is judgement, not a stack list. Auditing and fixing vulnerabilities in a financial suite before they become an incident. Turning business rules into traceable parameters instead of leaving them hardcoded. Treating Core Web Vitals as a requirement rather than decoration — that is the bar behind more than a hundred landing pages. And automating where it reduces risk: TaskForge, which orchestrates agents in parallel, cut 70% to 90% of the engineering LLM bill. When a subject is complex, explaining it is part of the delivery.
